nodes.label: Agent rules reference (verbatim pre-D-324 rule text, on demand)
nodes.description: On-demand reference holding, word for word, the pre-refactor AGENTS.md text that D-324 moved out of the automatically loaded rule files (D-337). No tool loads it automatically; the operative rules are AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md, and the Register decides conflicts.
